title: Supervised student teams received two national first prizes and one national second prize at the 2026 China College Students Mechanical Engineering Innovation and Creativity Competition—Intelligent Equipment Innovation Design Competition.

Supervised student teams received one national first prize and one national second prize at the 2026 China College Students Mechanical Engineering Innovation and Creativity Competition—Mingshi Cup Micro/Nano Sensing Technology and Intelligent Applications Competition.
A supervised student presented “A Modular Multi-DOF Planar Upper-Limb Rehabilitation Robot” at The 2nd International Young Leaders Forum 2026 (IYLF 2026) and received the Best Poster Award Runner-up.
Supervised student teams received one national first prize and one national second prize at the 19th Advanced Robot and Simulation Technology Competition.
A supervised student presented a poster titled “A Modular Multi-DOF Planar Upper-Limb Rehabilitation Robot” at the 7th China Robot Academic Annual Conference.
A supervised student team received a national second prize at the 18th Anniversary Elite League of the National 3D Digital Innovation Design Competition.
Six supervised College Student Innovation and Entrepreneurship Training Program projects were approved: one national, one provincial, and four university-level projects.
Three supervised undergraduate theses were recognized as Outstanding Undergraduate Theses (Designs) by Zhengzhou University; one also received an Excellence Award in the AI+ Thesis Challenge Project.
“Development of a Multi-DOF Robot Based on Serial–Parallel Mechanism for Dynamic Cervical Traction” was accepted by IEEE CASE 2026.
A supervised student team received a national second prize at the 2026 China Robot Competition and RoboCup China Open.
A supervised student team received a provincial gold award at the 2026 Challenge Cup Henan Provincial College Student Entrepreneurship Competition.
Awarded a Henan Young Talent Support Program project on key technologies for rehabilitation robots driven by rigid–flexible coupling.
Joined the Henan Key R&D Program project on a brain–computer-interface hand rehabilitation robot as a core team member.
Awarded a Henan Postdoctoral Research Project on robotic technologies for active rehabilitation of lumbar disc herniation.
A supervised student team received a national second prize at the 19th iCAN College Student Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition.
“Evaluating Trunk Control Ability in Patients With Spinal Cord Injury via a Robotic Brace” was published in IEEE Transactions on Biomedical Engineering.
Awarded the National Natural Science Foundation of China Young Scientists Fund (C) for high-compatibility variable-stiffness trunk rehabilitation robot design and control.
Awarded an open research project from the Shanghai Key Laboratory of Wearable Robotics and Human–Robot Interaction on compatible design and control of variable-stiffness rehabilitation robots.
The supervised project “Trunk Motion Intention Recognition Based on Flexible Pressure Sensors” was recognized as an Outstanding Undergraduate Thesis (Design) by Zhengzhou University.
